svg.title: Tapered flap on the ghost mini wallet
svg.desc: The top of the wallet rectangle. Rows 29 and 30 are 16 stitches. Row 31 decreases at each end to 14, row 32 to 12, row 33 to 10. Row 34 is 3 single crochet, a chain-5 loop over 4 skipped stitches, and 3 single crochet. Each decrease row moves both edges in by one stitch, a quarter inch at 4 stitches per inch, so the flap narrows from 4 inches to 2.5 inches over three rows. To the right, a note shows the pocket depth of 14 rows, 2.8 inches, against a 2.125 inch card and a dollar bill folded in half to 2.61 inches.
svg.text: The flap narrows by one stitch at each end, three times
Each dec row: both edges move in 0.25 in.
Pocket 14 rows = 2.8 in deep. Card 2.125 in.
A US bill folded in half is 3.07 x 2.61 in. It fits too.
